records.title: Director, Product Management

jd.text:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Director, Product Management
Overview
Mastercard Identity, within the Security Solutions organization, develops innovative products and services that enable trusted digital interactions across commerce, payments, financial services, government, and emerging digital ecosystems.
We are seeking a Director, Product Development, to help shape and deliver the next generation of Mastercard's Digital Identity solutions. This individual will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, defining product requirements, influencing product strategy, and driving execution across a rapidly evolving digital identity landscape. The role requires a deep understanding of digital identity technologies, ecosystem dynamics, emerging industry standards, and customer needs.
The successful candidate will work across a highly matrixed global organization and serve as a trusted thought partner to engineering, commercialization, legal, security, regional, and executive stakeholders. Expertise in merchant-facing, acceptance, authentication, commerce, or customer journey-related products is highly desirable. Candidates who can think across issuer, merchant, identity, authentication, wallet, and trust ecosystems will be particularly successful in this role.
Role
Product Strategy & Development
Identify emerging customer needs, market opportunities, and industry trends that can shape future product investments.
Develop business cases and strategic recommendations supporting product growth and innovation.
Drive delivery of product initiatives from concept through launch and market adoption.
Identity solutions and related product features, prioritize roadmap , and work within the organization to align to business problems .
Partner closely with engineering and platform teams to ensure successful execution of product priorities.
Identity build, buy, partner needs, working with external solutions and technology partners where and when needed.
Support commercialization activities, market expansion initiatives, pilot programs, and customer engagements.
Digital Identity Subject Matter Expertise
Serve as an expert in digital identity and trusted digital interactions.
Maintain deep knowledge of digital identity technologies, credential ecosystems, trust frameworks, digital wallets, authentication, authorization, and identity verification capabilities.
Understand developments across standards bodies, industry alliances, technology providers, competitors, and emerging market models.
Evaluate industry developments and their potential impact on Mastercard's product strategy, customer opportunities, and long-term positioning.
Support internal thought leadership on the evolution of digital identity and trust ecosystems.
Ecosystem & Industry Engagement
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, technology providers, industry groups, standards organizations, and other key stakeholders.
Engage with the broader digital identity community to understand market needs, technology trends, and emerging opportunities.
Assess partnership opportunities and ecosystem developments that could accelerate product growth and innovation.
Represent Mastercard in relevant industry discussions, working groups, conferences, and external engagements as appropriate.
Product Performance & Market Success
Define and monitor key performance indicators, adoption metrics, customer outcomes, and product success measures.
Gather customer feedback, market insights, and competitive intelligence to inform roadmap evolution.
Develop recommendations to improve product performance, customer adoption, and commercial outcomes.
Support investment decisions and prioritization discussions through data-driven analysis and business case development.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Lead complex initiatives across multiple functions and stakeholder groups.
Influence decision-making without direct authority in a highly matrixed environment.
Build alignment among engineering, commercialization, legal, compliance, security, privacy, regional, and executive stakeholders.
Communicate effectively with technical, business, and executive audiences.
Drive clarity and execution in ambiguous and rapidly evolving market environments.
All About You
Required Experience
Significant experience in Product Management, Product Development or related disciplines.
Experience working within digital identity, authentication, cybersecurity, payments, fintech, digital trust, fraud, or adjacent technology sectors.
Demonstrated success defining business requirements, and roadmap priorities.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
Strong commercial mindset with experience evaluating market opportunities and customer needs.
Comfortable operating in global and highly matrixed organizations.
Preferred Expertise
Deep expertise in digital identity ecosystems and market participants.
Strong understanding of one or more of the following key areas:
Digital wallets
Reusable identity
Digital credentials
Credential lifecycle management
Identity verification
Identity standards and protocols
Trust frameworks
Merchant-facing services, acceptance ecosystems, or customer-facing digital experiences
Ability to think across the broader ecosystem, including issuers, merchants, financial institutions, digital wallets, trust service providers, and identity providers.
Demonstrated ability to translate industry expertise and emerging market trends into scalable products and solutions within complex, highly matrixed organizations
Understanding privacy, security, and regulatory considerations that influence digital identity solutions globally.
Skills
Exceptional product management and strategic thinking skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
Ability to thrive in ambiguity and navigate rapidly changing market conditions.
Self-starter capable of independently driving initiatives through execution.
Education
Bachelor's degree, or significant related industry experience is required.
Advanced degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, , Computer Science, or related field preferred.

Title and Summary
Manager, Product Management – Payment Resiliency (Stand-In & On-Demand Decisioning)
Manager, Product Management – Payment Resiliency
Issuers face a myriad of authorization risks that come in many forms. Crisis events, such as cyberattacks or natural disasters, complex payment rails and systems, and evolving regulatory demands, like DORA all create disruption to the payment experience. The Mastercard Payment Resiliency team manages a suite of solutions to mitigate these risks. It is critical to ensure a frictionless cardholder experience and uphold the integrity of the Mastercard brand by providing on-behalf authorization decisioning, at any time, for any reason.
As Manager, Product Management - Payments Resiliency, you will help deliver on our strategy of offering industry leading authorization solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to aid in the creation and enhancement of resiliency products, drive utilization through customer education, and ultimately support the improvement of customer performance and profitability.
We’re seeking a collaborative and results-oriented product professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You are passionate about the cardholder experience, driving issuer change, and delivering impactful solutions. The role requires a highly analytical thinker who can connect data, market dynamics, customer needs, and business priorities to influence decisions and outcomes. As a natural leader and team player, you excel in building relationships and driving strategic outcomes with energy, creativity, and accountability.
Primary Responsibilities:
Function as a Payment Resiliency Solutions SME in Europe
Work closely with regional sales and account management teams to support the growth of our solutions
Partner with Advisors Consulting Services to drive product performance improvement and to define use case opportunities
Collaborate closely with local Customer Success and Service Business Leads by providing SME guidance and recommendations in support of their efforts
Craft and present clear and compelling business cases to stakeholders to secure buy-in for product utilization
Transform complex data into compelling insights, shape business narratives, and identify opportunities to create value across a diverse set of stakeholders
Work with engineering to enhance Resiliency offerings because of direct customer feedback
Identify issues, risks, and dependencies to track product development
Conduct market research to identify industry trends and competitive analysis
All About You:
Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Works to establish priorities and clear milestones and works with urgency to drive the delivery of tangible outcomes.
A problem-solver mindset with a focus on delivering value to the business and end-users. Experience working directly with partners and customers.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated success in both building relationships and working independently.
Strong attention to detail and ability to structure tasks efficiently while managing multiple projects simultaneously.
A natural self-starter – analyzing complex issues, identifying opportunities, and developing actionable plans.
Familiarity with authorization decisioning and related concepts
Background & qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Analytics , or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
At least 5+ years of experience in business analytics, strategy, product management, consulting, payments, financial services, or a related field.
Experience with value realization and performance optimization programs is a plus

Title and Summary
Manager Channel Sales & Partnerships - Europe
Mastercard Services, the professional services arm of Mastercard Worldwide, provides payments-focused consulting, marketing, platforms, information, loyalty and risk management services to financial institutions, retailers and government worldwide. The Data & Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centred on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test & Learn experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management services.
Overview:
The channel manager is a revenue-producing role that is responsible for developing and managing relationships with a defined portfolio of partners. The role is responsible for selective new partner recruitment, partner engagement in Mastercard’s channel program, joint partner business planning for specific partners, and enabling the partners’ sales resources and supporting their sales efforts.
About the Role:
Meet assigned targets for revenues through new channel partners
Define the desired profile of potential partners with the help of management
Research, identify, qualify and screen potential partners that align with the target partner profile
Gain qualified partners’ commitment to becoming engaged and productive by formulating and conveying a compelling business proposition
Prior to finalizing contract negotiations with each partner, develop a joint business plan (including sales targets) that is aligned with the Mastercard standards and strategy
Maintain a solid pipeline of qualified prospective partners to meet established recruitment targets
Drive onboarding and activating new partners; focus on ensuring the partners’ team members are enabled, equipped and motivated to sell, market, deploy and support the Mastercard offering within established timeframes
Engage Mastercard resources and stakeholders in support of partnership objectives and sales opportunities (e.g. direct sales, Product Liaisons, marketing, etc)
Manage channel pipeline and forecast reporting and track progress through the sales cycle
Drive monthly partner alignment sessions to review partners’ pipelines, conduct win/loss analysis, and develop account penetration strategies to identify and build new sales opportunities
Work with high-performing and high-potential partners to develop an annual joint business plan that defines strategies and activities to meet revenue goals; review and assess plan progress in partner-facing quarterly business reviews, making changes as appropriate
Provide partner and market feedback loop to internal functions (e.g. sales, product, marketing) on tools and programs
Assist in field marketing activities (e.g. staff a trade show booth, deliver sales presentations)
About You - Background/Experience:
At least five years of channel sales experience with proven success in recruiting and developing new partners, ideally within the TRAVEL services category and corresponding channels
Experience sourcing, qualifying, screening and forming business relationships with channel partners at C level
Experience developing and managing joint business planning with partners, ideally in the context of Travel related services
Strong personal network within the Travel and Tourism industry is a plus
Success Metrics:
Average length of time to revenue
New partner pipeline coverage to quota/target
Number of new partners and new partner revenue compared to quota/target
Activity supporting quota/target (e.g. number of prospect calls, meetings, partners signed)
Partner attrition rate
Partner satisfaction
Average cost of recruiting and activating new partners

Title and Summary
Principal Agentic Platforms Architect
The AI Center of Excellence is seeking a Principal Agentic Platforms Architect to lead the technical vision, architecture, and hands-on development of Mastercard’s enterprise agentic AI platforms. This role requires deep, demonstrated expertise building and shipping production-grade AI and agentic systems at enterprise scale, combined with the architectural rigor required in a highly regulated and security-conscious environment
Reporting to senior leadership, you will own the end-to-end platform architecture for agentic AI systems, spanning runtime orchestration, governance, model and tool integration, multi-tenancy, production deployment, and operational lifecycle management. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will write and review production code, establish engineering standards, and drive the team toward the highest levels of security, resilience, performance, and engineering excellence
Responsibilities
Own the enterprise agentic AI platform architecture, including runtime environments, orchestration, governance, multi-tenancy, policy enforcement, guardrails, observability, evaluation, and production lifecycle management
Lead hands-on architecture and development of scalable agentic systems, including multi-agent coordination, A2A communication, memory governance, tool calling, Model Context Protocol, human-in-the-loop workflows, and autonomous decision-making patterns
Drive model and platform integration strategy, enabling model-agnostic execution across providers while establishing intelligent routing, cost optimization, abstraction layers, and enterprise governance controls
Architect API-first platform capabilities that allow internal teams and external consumers to build, deploy, govern, and operate AI agents through secure, scalable, language-agnostic interfaces.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform, including architecture, code quality, security, resilience, performance, compliance, and operational excellence. Provide rigorous technical direction through architecture reviews and code reviews
Serve as the senior technical authority and advisor for agentic AI architecture, translating complex technical decisions into clear business and executive-level recommendations while mentoring engineers and strengthening the organization’s technical capabilities
Establish architectural governance and documentation, including system designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, and engineering standards aligned with Mastercard’s security and technology principles
All About You
12+ years of hands-on software and AI engineering experience, with substantial experience designing, building, and shipping enterprise AI/ML systems into production at scale
Proven experience architecting production-grade agentic AI systems, autonomous agents, multi-agent platforms, or AI-powered automation operating with real users, real data, and real business impact
Deep hands-on coding expertise, particularly in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks. Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent is highly valued
Strong cloud-native architecture expertise across platforms such as AWS, Databricks, and Kubernetes, with a demonstrated ability to design highly available, fault-tolerant, secure, and horizontally scalable systems
Deep expertise in AI governance, trust, and safety, including guardrails, policy engines, behavioral monitoring, evaluation, red teaming, compliance, and enterprise risk controls
Experience building enterprise platforms and data architectures, including multi-tenant systems, fine-grained authorization, identity and access management, API-first architectures, data lakehouse patterns, Delta Lake, vector databases, and RAG pipelines
Strong understanding of model-agnostic AI architectures and tool integration, including multi-provider LLM integration, tool calling, orchestration, and abstraction patterns
Exceptional technical and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, simplify complex architecture decisions, and build alignment across engineering and business organizations
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship, with a reputation for high standards, intellectual curiosity, resilience, and developing engineers into stronger technical leaders
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred but not required with equivalent experience

jd.text:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Title and Summary
Associate Consultant, Launch Program 2027 – Milan/Rome, Italy
Associate Consultant, Launch Program – 2027- Milan/Rome, Italy
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program?
Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact.
Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard.
About the team
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.
What you’ll do
As an Associate Consultant, you will:
collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions.
create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.
Specialization Tracks
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting four specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.
Strategy & Transformation
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?
Team members typically support 1-3 projects concurrently, with each project lasting for approximately 8-16 weeks.
Performance Analytics
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?
Team members support typically support several customers concurrently and include both short- and long-term projects that can last anywhere from 4 weeks up to 1 year.
Marketing
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?
Team members typically support 1-3 projects from any domain and build fundamental marketing and consulting toolkit.
Deploy
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution.
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams?
What governance structure, implementation roadmap, and stakeholder engagement plan will best position a client to deliver a large-scale transformation on time and within scope?
How can a client accelerate adoption and maximize the value of a newly deployed platform, product, or technology investment across its organization?
Team members typically support 1-2 projects or customers concurrently in execution and implementation. These projects are usually for 6-12 months.
What we’re looking for
Undergraduate or accelerated master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2026 - August 2027
Eligibility to work
This position does not have a compensation range. The fixed annual salary for this position is EUR 43,475 gross.
We recruit for and value the following core competencies:
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks).
Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.
Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.
Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.
Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
To participate in our job simulation and experience what it’s like to work as a Consultant at Mastercard visit: https://www.theforage.com/simulations/mastercard/advisors-client-services-xvlw

Job Title:
Vice President, Controller - Core Payments
The Vice President, Controller - Core Payments reports to the SVP, Assistant Corporate Controller, and serves as the senior controllership leader responsible for the integrity, governance, audit readiness, and financial reporting environment for the business unit, with particular focus on blockchain and digital payments. This role operates as a strategic partner to global and regional finance teams, Treasury, Corporate Controllership, business leadership, and the Global Business Shared Service Organization (GBSC), providing authoritative accounting judgment and driving consistent execution across a complex global operating environment. The position will help establish and mature a best-in-class controllership function for a highly complex, strategically important, and recently acquired Mastercard business, including oversight of relevant legal entity, statutory, regulatory, treasury, and governance considerations.
Roles and Responsibilities
Serve as the senior controllership advisor to business and finance leadership, providing accounting judgment on complex transactions, business models, digital asset and stablecoin-related activities, revenue recognition, balance sheet classification, and evolving regulatory matters.
Drive consistent application of accounting policies, controls, and reporting practices across global and regional teams, including coordination with Corporate Controllership, Technical Accounting, Regional Controllers, GBSC, Tax, Legal, Treasury, and business partners.
Own senior-level engagement with external auditors and support statutory, internal, regulatory, and other required audits, including audit documentation, issue resolution, and alignment across relevant controllership and GBSC teams.
Oversee compliance, governance, and financial integrity for relevant business activities and legal entities, including SOX, Internal Audit, ORM, statutory reporting, local audit requirements, and escalation of potential exposures to senior leadership.
Define and execute the compliance integration roadmap for the acquired business, including identification of applicable regulatory, statutory, SOX, data/privacy, third-party, and financial reporting obligations; assessment of current-state gaps; alignment to Mastercard policy requirements; and development of remediation plans.
Establish robust compliance reporting for the integration period, including risk and issue tracking, milestone reporting, evidence retention, control-gap status, audit finding resolution, and clear visibility to senior leadership on items that could impact financial reporting, regulatory compliance, or integration readiness.
Ensure the acquired company maintains audit-ready documentation throughout integration, including process narratives, control evidence, reconciliations, management review support, policy exception approvals, local statutory and regulatory filing support, and formal attestations required before system migration or reporting process transition.
Ensure compliant legacy processes are maintained until transition, including identification of changes to business activities or regulatory obligations, support for timely data and evidence requests, participation in control walkthroughs and remediation efforts, and confirmation of readiness for policy, process, system, and organizational handoffs.
Maintain a legal-entity-level statutory compliance register for the digital payments business, including jurisdictional filing deadlines, audit requirements, financial statement preparation obligations, licensing or regulatory reporting triggers, and local reporting requirements.
Oversee statutory compliance activities specific to digital payments, stablecoins, crypto assets, settlement, safeguarding, and money movement, including coordination with Legal, Compliance, Treasury, Tax, and Corporate Controllership teams to assess requirements driven by regulated activity, regulatory capital or liquidity obligations, and country-specific financial reporting expectations.
Own the assessment, documentation, and recurring review of divergent accounting conclusions across US GAAP, IFRS, and applicable local GAAP frameworks, including revenue recognition, gross versus net presentation, digital asset classification and measurement, customer safeguarding obligations, settlement balances, foreign currency, intercompany, tax, and statutory bridge adjustments required to support consolidated and local financial reporting.
Establish controlled US GAAP-to-local GAAP bridge processes for relevant legal entities, including clear ownership of adjustment preparation and review, linkage to statutory ledgers, reconciliation of intercompany and settlement positions to statutory financial statements, review of material manual journal entries, and retention of support sufficient for external audit, statutory audit, and regulatory inspection.
Drive periodic reviews to confirm statutory reporting readiness, emerging GAAP or regulatory changes, bridge adjustment complexity, audit dependencies, and remediation status across the acquired company’s digital payments footprint.
Lead monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc management reporting, including variance analysis, technical position support, executive presentations, and recurring or ad hoc updates to senior management and applicable governance forums.
All About You
The successful candidate will be a strategic, senior-level controller with deep technical accounting expertise, strong leadership judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, evolving, and highly regulated global environment.

As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.
Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. records.title: AWS Transport Business Development Manager, Central Government, Transport

jd.text:
Are you passionate about the future of transportation and helping organisations transform how they deliver critical infrastructure and mobility services? Do you have the business acumen and technology leadership background necessary to help establish Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a key technology platform provider across the UK's transport sector?
This is an exciting opportunity to drive growth and shape the future of cloud-native technology adoption across some of the UK's most strategically important transport organisations. You will advise senior public sector leaders on technology strategy and drive adoption across a portfolio spanning rail, roads, aviation, regional transport, and regulatory bodies — helping them harness cloud-native analytics, real-time operations management, and AI-powered optimisation to deliver better outcomes for the travelling public.
You will be joining at a pivotal moment. The UK Government is delivering the most significant restructuring of Britain's railways in a generation through Great British Railways, investing £24 billion in motorways and local roads (2026–2030), and empowering city region transport authorities to lead a £15.6 billion regional investment programme. Across every mode, the challenge is the same: do more with existing networks through technology, not just concrete.
You will possess both a customer-obsessed attitude and a deep understanding of how UK transportation organisations operate — from safety-critical operational environments to complex multi-stakeholder governance — and the challenges they face when making technology decisions. You will have the profile and credibility to facilitate high-level engagement with senior government and industry leaders, and an ability to build relationships at all levels within customer organisations, driving tangible outcomes aligned with the government's vision for technology-enabled transport networks. You are a self-starter who wants to build a business, drive measurable customer outcomes, and make a real difference in how the UK moves.
Key job responsibilities
You will help drive revenue growth and market segment share by developing and executing against a comprehensive business development plan for the UK Transport sector. Central to this is creating and maintaining long-term strategic relationships with Transport leaders, while facilitating strong engagement with key officials, policy makers, advisors, and delivery partners across the ecosystem. You will help define AWS' Transport sector strategy, developing and articulating compelling value propositions around AWS services that resonate with the unique challenges of this market. A key focus will be accelerating customer adoption and strategic partnerships — working with global infrastructure providers, system integrators, and ISVs to extend our reach and drive joint solutions. Throughout, you will ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction, acting as a trusted advisor who balances commercial ambition with genuine customer obsession.
A day in the life
You will present thought leadership and build trusted relationships with senior management teams across the transport sector, positioning AWS as a strategic partner for their most complex challenges. A core part of the role involves identifying and engaging key partners — including global infrastructure providers, system integrators, consulting firms, and ISVs — to extend our reach and deliver compelling joint solutions. You will support builders who develop innovative transportation solutions on AWS, while also understanding the technical requirements of our customers and feeding these insights into our Go-To-Market strategy. Working closely with multiple internal and external stakeholders, you will create cross-industry opportunities that connect transport with adjacent sectors such as smart cities, energy, and logistics. You will serve as a key member of the international Transport ecosystem, collaborating with global peers to share best practice and scale proven approaches. Throughout, you will present regular business reviews to the senior management team, communicating progress, pipeline development, and roadblocks to expanding our reach across the industry.
About the team
The AWS Transport team sits within UK Public Sector and is dedicated to helping the UK's transport organisations deliver better outcomes through cloud technology. We work across rail, aviation, roads, and regional transport — partnering with some of the country's most complex and strategically important organisations as they navigate generational transformation programmes.
Our mission is to be the trusted technology partner that enables the UK transport sector to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. We believe that cloud, data, and AI are fundamental enablers of the government's vision for a modern, integrated transport network.
We are a collaborative, ambitious team that values diverse perspectives and deep customer empathy. We operate with a start-up mentality within the scale of AWS — meaning you'll have the autonomy to shape your territory strategy while being supported by world-class technical, partner, and specialist resources. We celebrate curiosity, reward ownership, and are passionate about making a tangible difference in how millions of people travel every day.

We're seeking a Technical Program Manager II to revolutionize how we leverage agentic AI solutions to deliver data-driven insights at scale. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of advanced analytics, AI capabilities, and technical program management to support International Operations Technology Services (OTS) customer operations.
You'll be instrumental in establishing data frameworks that enable fast, evidence-backed decision making for our global customers. This is a unique opportunity to apply deep analytical expertise and AI systems to create scalable solutions that help our customers operate efficiently and make informed choices about where and how to deploy resources.
Key job responsibilities
Drive end-to-end delivery of data analytics and AI-enabled programs by planning, coordinating, and managing cross-functional initiatives that support International OTS customer operations decision making and reporting
Collaborate with engineering teams and technical leaders to design and implement scalable data solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements while considering tradeoffs in performance, maintainability, and security
Navigate a matrix organization to identify data sources across verticals, synthesize complex information, and present actionable insights to director-level leadership using AI systems to accelerate analysis and presentation
Mitigate program delivery risks by proactively managing schedules, tracking progress, communicating with stakeholders, clearing blockers, and driving crisp decision making to meet project timelines
Mentor team members and optimize operational excellence procedures by identifying process improvements and incorporating system quality enhancements into project plans
A day in the life
You'll begin by collaborating with your team to align on data vision and requirements, working cross-functionally to understand what data is needed and where to source it. You'll spend time analyzing complex datasets using AI capabilities to uncover patterns and solutions. Throughout the day, you'll navigate across organizational boundaries to gather inputs, then synthesize your findings into compelling presentations for director-level stakeholders. You'll leverage AI systems to work faster and more efficiently, ensuring your recommendations are backed by solid evidence and deliver meaningful impact for customer operations.
About the team
You'll be reporting into the central team for OTS Finance and Data (FD) International, a group dedicated to enabling data-driven excellence across global customer operations. Our team operates at the forefront of innovation, combining technical expertise with business acumen to deliver solutions that matter. We work collaboratively across the International OTS directorship, supporting customer operations with timely, accurate data that drives strategic decisions.
We're building the future of controllership and data analytics through AI innovation. Our mission is to empower customers with the insights they need to operate with speed and precision. You'll join a team that values technical depth, continuous learning, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable strategies.

records.title: Operations Supervisor, Quick Commerce

jd.text:
Please be aware that this role requires a commitment of 32 hours per week.
Location: Wembley
Site location: Unit 14, Kingsbury Trading Estate, Barningham Way, Kingsbury, NW9 8AU
Shift Times & Days: 14:30-23:00 Mon/Tue/Wed/Sat
Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.
You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.
Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity
A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.
You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.
About the team
Quick Commerce (QC) delivers ultra-fast convenience through our network of small warehouse in city center locations, partnering with last-mile delivery providers to get products to customers in 30 minutes or less. We combine creative thinking and technological innovation to fulfill millions of urgent shopping missions, offering a curated selection of grocery items and Amazon essentials.
Our operations have two key components. Our 'under the roof' associates process orders with industry-leading speed, picking and packing customer orders to enable our 30-minute delivery promise. We operate with a people-first approach, with teams working across morning and afternoon shifts to serve customers seven days a week.
Meanwhile, our 'on the road' delivery network primarily utilizes Amazon Flex delivery partners on e-bikes specially optimized for rapid urban delivery. We continuously innovate to improve customer experience, focusing on sustainable delivery solutions in dense urban areas while maintaining strict quality and food safety standards.
Our team combines the best of Amazon's retail and logistics expertise, leveraging both Fresh and AMZL operational excellence. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous improvement, as we work to revolutionize convenience shopping through ultra-fast delivery.
Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

records.title: Category Manager Power & Utilities, Global Procurement Organization (GPO)

jd.text:
We are the Global Procurement Organization, and we're on a mission to reshape how one of the world's largest companies powers its operations with clean energy. We're looking for a Category manager to own and scale our on site solar energy portfolio across Europe, the UK, and the Middle East, driving hundreds of megawatts of new capacity and tens of millions in cost savings.
You'll be building the playbook for solar procurement in some of the fastest growing renewable energy markets on the planet. Own the full solar portfolio across a diverse set of markets from Western Europe to the Arabian Peninsula, where solar capacity is projected to grow 10x by 2035
Navigate complex regulatory landscapes from EU clean energy mandates to Saudi Vision 2030 and UAE's ambitious renewable targets
Structure creative deals deciding when to deploy capital purchases vs. power purchase agreements vs. operating lease models across markets with very different economics
Drive real sustainability impact your work will directly eliminate thousands of metric tons of CO2 annually while reducing grid dependency across hundreds of logistics facilities. Shape a category from the ground up in emerging Middle East markets, where solar is unlocking operations in locations where traditional grid connections aren't even possible
If you love solving complex problems across cultures and borders, and want your work to have measurable environmental and financial impact, this is the role.
Key job responsibilities
Develop and execute the long term sourcing strategy for on site solar across Europe, UK, and Middle East covering rooftop, carport, and ground mount technologies
Lead portfolio based tenders, bundling demand across multiple countries to maximize negotiation leverage and reduce procurement cycle times
Build financial models including net present value, total cost of ownership, and payback analysis to support investment decisions and senior leadership recommendations
Own strategic supplier relationships through quarterly business reviews, performance tracking, and capacity planning while maintaining competitive tension across the vendor base
Identify and mitigate supply chain risks including equipment lead times, trade policy shifts, and regional market constraints
Track energy production performance against forecasts and drive continuous improvement in system output and cost efficiency
Lead category consolidation efforts, bringing fragmented solar activities under a unified procurement framework to unlock savings and standardize specifications
A day in the life
Your day starts with a portfolio review call across European markets, then shifts to negotiating contract terms with a supplier for a compliance driven deployment. After lunch, you're deep in a financial model stress testing deal structures for a new Middle East opportunity. By afternoon, you're syncing with engineering, legal, finance, sustainability, and construction partners to keep projects on track. The variety is constant and no two days look the same as you move between strategy, negotiation, and execution across time zones.
About the team
You'll join the Power and Utilities team within Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We manage the full energy lifecycle for Amazon's worldwide operations across five areas: utilities supply and audits, power infrastructure and grid services, on site renewables and storage, EV charging infrastructure, and hydrogen mobility solutions. This role sits within the renewables and storage pillar, but you'll work alongside colleagues tackling everything from microgrids and demand response to hydrogen refueling and electric vehicle charging. We're a global team that is scaling fast and rewriting how large scale operations source, generate, and consume power.

records.title: Finance Manager, EU Fleet Finance

jd.text:
Job Summary
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) delivers millions of packages to customers every day across Amazon's Last Mile network. Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) operates a complex, dynamic Surface Transportation (ST) business. Supporting AMZL and ATS, the Global Fleet and Products (GFP) organization manages Fleet technology, capacity, vehicle in-life services programs, vendor management, planning and execution, and establishes vehicle requirements to move goods between Amazon Operations locations and deliver parcels to customers' doorsteps.
EU Fleet Finance is a specialized team of 8 finance professionals partnering with GFP in EU to drive strategic investment decisions and optimize fleet performance across 10 European countries. Finance is providing planning, analysis, and cost controllership for the middle and last mile fleet of tractors, trailers and delivery vehicles. Together with operations leaders and AMZL, ATS and DSP Finance organizations we optimize fleet costs, define vehicle economics, and shape Amazon's delivery model. Our work directly influences strategic decisions on preferred vehicle types, alternative mobility solutions, and partner remuneration models. We are continuously expanding this business partnership to international GFP activities.
The team is seeking a Finance Manager to connect team activities across sourcing, project and program activities, for both middle and last mile, coordinating and consolidating quantitative and qualitative information when it comes to planning and reporting. This role requires an experienced finance professional who will independently assess and handle priorities in an increasingly complex environment, ensuring appropriate stakeholder management.
Given our team's size and scope, you'll engage with numerous stakeholders across GFP operations teams and Finance organizations, providing subject matter expertise to senior leaders. You'll define, track and help to improve metrics measuring vehicle operating costs, cost per package, route economics, and kilometer efficiency. The role combines European-wide perspective with country-level insights, evolving with fleet lifecycle management, new vehicle acquisitions, and innovative sourcing models.
Key job responsibilities
Own, execute and develop financial reporting and planning processes for Middle and Last Mile Fleet cost: (1) Lead execution of Weekly Business Reviews, Month-End-Close, Monthly Financial Reviews, and planning cycles with limited oversight; (2) ensure accuracy through proactive auditing and key controllership activities CapEx and OpEx; (3) Build financial models addressing complex fleet cost questions; convert data into actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership;
Stakeholder Management: (1) ensure accurate and concise reporting on vehicle financials, relevant for multiple Finance teams; (2) communicate financial performance expectations and results to L8 operations stakeholders; (3) influence tactical and strategic fleet decisions to meet financial commitments;
Metrics Development: (1) Develop and track fleet economics metrics including cost per package, route, load and kilometer; (2) analyze vehicle operating costs across 10 European countries
Process Improvement: (1) Identify automation opportunities, reduce defects, and implement solutions that scale across the European fleet finance function; (2) support establishing WW process standards within WW Fleet Finance.
A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field
Relevant experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business
Relevant experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL or Tableau
Relevant experience in financial modelling
Advanced or master’s degree in finance, economics or mathematics, such as a CA, CMA, CWA or MBA
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organisation
Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influence decisions

Mission of the Role
The GTR FP&A Commercial Senior Specialist will support the Global Travel Retail business by strengthening financial governance, improving commercial decision-making, and ensuring consistency across regions, customers, channels, and key commercial finance processes.
The role will act as a central FP&A commercial finance point of contact for pricing, promotional investment, customer performance, margin analysis, strategic planning, and commercial analytics. It will provide robust financial insights to support profitable growth, stronger visibility of business drivers, and disciplined investment decisions across the GTR perimeter.
The position is designed to increase transparency, standardization, and control over key commercial finance activities, while progressively enabling automation and process simplification.
Key Responsibilities
Commercial Finance, Pricing and Investment Governance
Partner closely with regional commercial teams, marketing team, and finance stakeholders, including House of Brands.
Support the governance of price, promotion, discount, and DD investment management across Global Travel Retail regions, customers, and channels, to ensure alignment of assumptions, methodologies, accuracy and reporting standards.
Perform financial analysis on trade margin, value chain, customer profitability, pricing architecture, identifying risks and opportunities linked to customer terms, trade investments, discounts, and pricing actions.
Support financial assessments for innovation gates, new product launches, and commercial initiatives.
Support the preparation, validation, and tracking of price lists, price letters, SAP price loading, and related pricing processes.
Customer, Channel and Performance Analytics
Consolidate global customer performance across regions, customers, brands, and channels.
Enhance visibility of key commercial performance drivers, including Net Sales, Gross Profit, trade investments, promotional spending, and customer/channel profitability.
Support the development of P&L visibility by sub-channel, enabling better performance tracking and decision-making.
Assess the financial impact of alternative commercial scenarios, including price changes, discount structures, activation plans, and investment levels.
Strategic Planning and Forecasting
Support Strat Plan coordination for the GTR perimeter, ensuring alignment across regions, customers, and key commercial assumptions.
Contribute to budget, forecast planning processes with a strong focus on commercial drivers.
Prepare analysis and materials to support senior management discussions and business reviews.
Key Stakeholders
Finance Manager GTR
Global GTR Managing Director and leadership team
Regional GTR Sales teams
Customer, Channel & Marketing teams
BU FP&A team
Supply Chain Finance
Experience, education and skills
University degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or related field.
Solid experience in FP&A, commercial finance, business controlling, revenue growth management, or financial planning roles.
Experience in a multinational environment, ideally within FMCG, spirits, consumer goods, retail, travel retail, or commercial finance.
Strong understanding of P&L dynamics, Net Sales, Gross Profit, trade investments, discounts, promotion, pricing, customer profitability, and margin analysis.
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, strategic planning, and performance management processes.
Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SAP, planning tools, BI tools, or reporting platforms is a plus.
Fluent English; additional languages are a plus.
Soft Skills and Competencies
Strong business partnering attitude and ability to work cross-functionally.
High analytical rigor and attention to detail.
Ability to manage complexity across multiple regions, customers, and stakeholders.
Pragmatic problem-solving approach and continuous improvement mindset.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for non-finance stakeholders.
Proactive ownership and ability to work independently.
Resilience and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international environment.

The indicative annual gross salary (base salary) for this position ranges within 46.800 and 54.600 EUR + STI: 10%, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall profile.​
The role is classified in accordance with the Terziario Commercio e Servizi collective labor agreement – level 1.​
The position might also include a variable compensation component and a benefits package in line with applicable company policies.

Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.
JOB PURPOSE
The analyst is part of the Global FP&A team. This position will have a strong focus on the Retail channel and will be responsible for the preparation of the reports in order to monitor the Brand performances, the financial forecast/budget for the company and the profitability analysis by Region and Channel. The controller will support senior management, providing both strategic insights and in-depth analysis by working cross functionally across divisions/regions.
RESPONSABILITIES
Preparing management reports and KPIs, providing analysis of the key areas
Retail daily/weekly reporting for the top management, coordinating all regional teams
Monitoring Retail profitability, focusing on channels and seasonality
Coordinate the WW retail global tracking of new openings and closures in conjunction with all the regional teams and the HQ Real Estate department
Support the top Management with presentation, dashboards and performance indicators on all relevant projects
Supporting the preparation of Earning release analysis requested by the Holding
Supporting the preparation of budgets, reforecasts and 3-year plans in conjunction with all the different teams involved in the process
Assisting in Monthly and Quarterly closings and provide comments and analysis vs budgets
Carry out regular business performance analysis, analysing variances from budget/forecast, with focus on subsidiaries in conjunction with the opex controlling and consolidation teams
Monitoring Retail Capex spending against investment budgets and highlighting areas of overspend
KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
Bachelor's degree (Finance or Accounting preferred)
3-5 years’ experience as business controller, consulting or audit
Background of experience in a Fashion/Luxury company is a plus
Fluent in English
Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint
Experience with Planning tool/software, Hyperion and Tagetik a plus
Experience with business intelligence tools such as OBIEE and PowerBI is a plus
Good relationships skills, social intelligence and teamwork
Strong analytical, problem solving, organizational and interpersonal skills
Able to work under pressure in a complex & fast-changing environment

jd.text:
Join us as a Client Director to grow your career at the forefront of insurance distribution.
Make your mark in Client and Broker Engagement
Our Client and Broker Engagement (CBE) team manages AIG’s major client relationships across all product lines, as well as driving new business activity. The team serves major clients and broker partners through an elevated, personalised experience – our client-centric framework drives a consistent experience and best practice, while allowing flexibility to meet the client’s needs.
How you will create an impact
Our Client Directors ensure retention of existing business and identify and deliver a constant stream of targeted new business opportunities across the range of AIG products, by developing and maintaining relationships within a designated portfolio of major companies and by securing strong relationships with key business influencers within the major brokers.
Responsibilities:
Ensure retention of all existing "profitable" business within assigned portfolio in line with product renewal strategies;
Develop and maintain an understanding and working relationship with each company within the assigned portfolio in accordance with the client management process;
Facilitate AIG Corporate relationships at all levels with clients and development clients;
Acquisition of new business from development clients and prospects in accordance with the client management process.
Identify and maintain regular contact with key business influencers at major brokers on assigned portfolio and beyond;
Provide focal point for clients, development clients and prospects within the AIG organisation.
Understand clients and development clients corporate and insurance strategies enabling the Client Director to complete and maintain an account profile; establish an account strategy and ensure the account plan is agreed and executed; be known to both the Client and Client Service Team within Broker;
Identify new and cross sell business opportunities from designated portfolio of clients and development clients and co-ordinate sales process in accordance with the client management process;
Qualify prospects and convert them to clients and development clients in accordance with the client management process
Provide framework and guidance for effective service delivery on assigned portfolio through the client management process;
Maintain a working knowledge of all products and be aware of AIG appetite across the board;
What you’ll need to succeed
Extensive track record of managing major corporate client relationships as a broker, carrier or risk manager.
Experience of corporate insurance programmes both UK and multinational, particularly across main General Insurance products (P&C, Financial Lines, Specialty)
Strong written and verbal communication skills and proven interpersonal skills
Solid profile and reputation in the London commercial insurance market
Strong commercial background
Sales and business development experience
ACII preferable
Excellent IT skills
Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.
#LI-AIG
At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. jd.text:
Join us as as a Data & Digital Analyst to take your career to the next level with a global market leader.
How you will create an impact
You will support the design, delivery and adoption of data and digital capabilities across the business. This role sits at the intersection of business need, product thinking and platform delivery, working across Talbot’s core data and digital landscape.
The role is responsible for helping the business translate operational, analytical and strategic needs into practical, scalable data and digital solutions. It plays a critical bridge function between underwriting, operations and other business stakeholders and the platform teams, ensuring that solutions are well scoped, aligned to strategy, operationally viable and adopted by the business.
This role supports a complex and evolving digital and data landscape that includes:
Talisman as the enterprise data platform
Spectrum / Underwriting Workbench as key underwriting and operational tooling
Ongoing transformation work across digital and pricing capability
Data initiatives supporting reporting, controls, performance management and operational insight
Business enablement and adoption across multiple stakeholder groups
Key responsibilities
Work closely with underwriting, operations, finance, actuarial, pricing and broader business stakeholders to understand pain points, priorities and opportunities for digitisation and data improvement.
Translate business needs into clear requirements, solution options, process impacts and delivery-ready user stories or specification documents.
Support product and solution shaping across the Talbot data and digital portfolio, including underwriting workflows, data integration, reporting, operational processes and platform capabilities.
Partner with platform teams and delivery partners to assess feasibility, prioritise scope, define dependencies and support implementation planning.
Help shape and prioritise the backlog across multiple streams of work, balancing near-term business need with longer-term strategic goals.
Support design and governance activities for various change initiatives
Ensure solutions are aligned to business needs, platform architecture, risk and control requirements, and market operating standards.
Provide functional oversight of delivery progress, working with teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues and maintain focus on business value.
Support adoption of data and digital products by working with stakeholders to improve data literacy, define training needs and ensure business readiness.
Act as a business proxy within data and digital discussions, helping technology teams understand the operational context and helping business teams understand delivery constraints and trade-offs.
Monitor and report on product adoption, usage and effectiveness, helping to continuously improve value realisation.
What you'll need to succeed
Experience in a data, digital, product or business analysis role within insurance
Lloyd’s / London market experience desirable
Strong understanding of underwriting processes, operational workflows and how digital and data capabilities support them.
Experience working with business stakeholders to understand needs and shape practical solutions.
Ability to translate business problems into requirements, user stories, process models and solution options.
Strong understanding of data platforms, reporting, workflow tools and digital transformation in a business context.
Experience supporting or influencing delivery across cross-functional teams, including technology, platform, operations and business stakeholders.

jd.text:
Join us as our International Head of Fraud & Recovery to grow your career at the forefront of insurance claims.
Make your mark in Claims
Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency
How you will create an impact
This position is responsible for managing the overall fraud and recovery program across AIG’s International business. The position requires proven leadership skills in managing a team of regional managers across 5 regions: APAC and China, Europe Middle East Africa, UK, Latin America and Japan.
The scope of the fraud role supports AIG to reduce the potential economic loss to the business through the identification and investigation of suspicious insurance claims or suspicious insurance related activities covering all lines of business.
The scope of the recovery role supports AIG’s strategy of maximizing recovery opportunity whilst minimizing recovery expenses, ensuring that there is consistency with the way recovery activity is enabled, tracked, monitored and reported.
Critical to the success of this position is the ability to engage, lead and inspire a team of fraud, recovery and salvage professionals to continue to deliver high quality results while creating the fraud and recovery capability of the future. This will involve leveraging new technology and skills and developing new and innovative techniques to help support and achieve AIG GI Claims goals, whilst at the same time developing and nurturing an organizational culture aligned to AIG’s defined purpose and values.
Key responsibilities:
Support the execution of the GI Claims Fraud and Recovery strategy, including deployment of global fraud and recovery technology initiatives, portfolio analytics, TPA governance, vendor management, shared services engagement and expense management.
Create and implement strategies to maximise recovery value and mitigate fraud risk aligned to the Global Fraud and Recovery Key Performance Indicators.
Proven ability to build strong networks with claims, underwriting and external stakeholders and have a proven track record of delivering outstanding results.
Support the advancement of the fraud and recovery reporting and portfolio analytics capability to enable timely reporting and to produce valuable insights to key stakeholders.
Drive strong data citizenship on critical data fields within fraud and recovery related tools and systems to develop accuracy of the Key Performance Indicators.
Support and engage in identified data, digital and Gen AI strategies through targeted engagement and knowledge sharing to ensure fraud and recovery capabilities have been incorporated.
Proactively drive an effective communication and engagement process with key stakeholders regarding the fraud and recovery value proposition, results, recommendations and internal/ external trends.
Work with claims and underwriting teams to understand where fraud exposure exists and where recovery opportunity is available.
Collaborate on new growth setups (e.g. TPA/ MGAs), new product designs and customer initiatives through assessing the impact on recovery and inherent fraud risk and ensuring the right operating model is in place.
Assess the performance of the international fraud and recovery vendor panel, ensuring vendor performance is of the highest quality, delivering value with appropriate expense discipline.
Manage the implementation and monitor the effectiveness of the international fraud and recovery training and awareness campaigns for Claims and Underwriting.
Plan, manage and evaluate work of staff; make decisions regarding pay, performance management, development, employment and staffing requirements.
Ensure compliance with all country laws and regulations regarding fraud and recovery best practices, guidelines, reporting and submissions and data privacy requirements.
Function as the AIG liaison and point of contact for Global Fraud Industry associations and regional/country regulators, law enforcement etc. where required.
Manage expenses within established and approved budget guidelines.
What you’ll need to succeed
Extensive knowledge of claims, insurance markets, fraud and recovery legislation and handling processes, along with other relevant data/ compliance legislation.
Connectivity with relevant fraud and recovery industry associations, with demonstrable credibility.
Ability to leverage technology and analytics to achieve goals including experience in the implementation of AI and Machine learning to assess trends and identify opportunities to drive improved results.
Able to lead complex change initiatives with an ability to work to tight timelines when necessary.
Experience and confidence to lead a large, diverse team and engage a geographically dispersed group of stakeholders.
Comfortable working across differing time zones to support engagement of regional fraud and recovery teams and to actively contribute to the global leadership team.
Able to take ownership of their area of responsibility and work with others to win together in both virtual and in person environments, helping to develop and nurture a high-performance culture.
Excellent communication skills with a strong collaborative mindset to influence stakeholders internally within Fraud and Recovery and other key stakeholders (International/Regional/ LOB claims stakeholders, Underwriters, Actuaries, Risk Compliance, Legal, Vendors, Customers etc).
Ready to set new industry standards? We would love to hear from you.

records.title: Lead Analyst  - Legal Entity Capital Modelling and Production

jd.text:
Join us as a Lead Analyst, Legal Entity Capital Modelling and Production, to take your career to the next level with a global market leader.
How you will create an impact
Reporting to the Head of Legal Entity Capital Modeling and Production, you will support the production processes across Global Risk and the Capital Modeling and Analytics team including the Group Capital Model, two Solvency II approved Internal Models for both UK and Europe, other local legal entity models and support to Talbot models as appropriate.
The Legal Entity capital models for UK and Europe are used in assessment of Capital Adequacy, Portfolio Management, Risk Management, Asset Management and Reinsurance Management and have approval under Solvency II from their respective regulators. In addition, the team maintains other legal entity capital models, currently Canada and Bermuda models, which support local legal entity risk management and Own Risk and Solvency reporting (ORSA) requirements.
Production processes consist of supporting regular updates of all models, including collection of inputs, quality assurance, implementing controls and validation tests, production of results, analysis of change and assisting with presentations. Furthermore, production includes review and optimization of processes via the creation of new tools and automation as required.
Some of the key responsibilities include:
Produce and present model output and changes for key projects to business stakeholders.
Support business partners with use requirements: Risk Officers with updates to Risk Reporting, Risk Appetite monitoring, Stress Testing, ORSA
Capital Management for Overall Capital Assessments
Reinsurance Officers for Reinsurance Adequacy
Market Risk Officers for analytics on the Investment Portfolio
Support the production of quarterly Internal Model baselines for Group, UK, Europe, Canada and Bermuda legal entities for presentation committees or regulators as appropriate.
Support initiatives to integrate production processes across AIG’s Capital Models (including Group and Talbot where appropriate) to achieve a unified annual run calendar, and common working practices and quality assurance leading to greater resilience.
Keep both the Internal Model and Standard Formula up to date with Regulatory Changes, changes in the company’s risk profile and changes in external environment.
Update logs, reports, testing and documentation such as the Technical Issues log, Expert Judgement Log, Sensitivity Testing Report and Model documentation.
What you'll need to succeed
MSc in a quantitative field, Qualified Actuary or equivalent
5+ years of experience in capital modeling for a General Insurance company
Experience in actuarial pricing or reserving is beneficial.
Experience in the regulation of Solvency II in relation to Internal Models and good background knowledge of other related regulatory regimes.
Able to work with senior business partners and Risk Officers, and present model outputs to internal and external stakeholders
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a global team environment
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Strong quality control and review skills both qualitative and quantitative
Understanding of risk management tools and risk quantification techniques for all risk areas
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience with capital modeling packages, in particular Igloo, and programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab and VBA would be beneficial
